strongest_objection: The map's declared central item, Rising floor, is written with the same carrier as runway-illusions' Watched burn: 'the counterparty's reading of the remaining clock' is exactly the investor who reads the bank statement and the buyer whose diligence finds the runway and waits, and Watched burn already holds a delayed arrival as one of its cases. The item's only separating clause, 'even the willing arrive slower', names no mechanism, and the observed evidence it cites (long-term unemployed hired slower) is not slower willing employers but fewer of them: the clock read as a signal about the party thins the field, which is a different mechanism from the clock read as a bargaining position that moves the price. The fixed-point claim survives and is the map's best idea, but as written the item is Watched burn plus a formalism, and the of-sentence demands a distinct carrier. The second fault is the seriation's own consequential adjacency, Gestation to Clean months: it rests on 'a purchase at one item and a fraud at the next', yet the later-stage purchase of a record exists and is legal (buy the company with the filed accounts), and it fails not because it is fraud but because the counterparty's watch is attached to the party and re-attaches on change of control; the fraud is the attempt to carry the record across anyway. The map also files 'a residency's years before citizenship' under Gestation when its own discriminator (a witness must have been kept) puts it in Clean months. I tried to break the fork, the dependency, the recruitment, and the passage and could not; the loop and the incompatibility hold once their antecedents are stated so they can fail.

items.item: Gestation: the replacement must grow, as the crop that takes a season, the herd that takes a gestation and a weaning, timber, a barrel's years, a residency's years before citizenship, so the lead time is a count of elapsed time no money converts; the carrier is the thing's own rate of becoming, it is shortened only by buying the thing at a later stage, a heifer rather than a calf, a running business rather than a plan, which is buying someone else's elapsed time, and it is faked by the seed in the ground counted as the crop; not Staggered stand, which is the purchase of starting, since Gestation is the reason the stand is the only purchase, and not Calendar with nothing in it, since here the time is an ingredient and something is growing in it.
items.why: 'A residency's years before citizenship' is a run of periods the state watches and records, with continuous residence as the evidence rule; by the map's own discriminator between Gestation and Clean months (whether a witness had to be kept) it belongs to Clean months. Nothing else in the item fails; one example is misfiled and moved.
items.repair: Gestation: the replacement must grow, as the crop that takes a season, the herd that takes a gestation and a weaning, timber, a barrel's years, an orchard's years before it bears, so the lead time is a count of elapsed time no money converts; the carrier is the thing's own rate of becoming, it is shortened only by buying the thing at a later stage, a heifer rather than a calf, a running business rather than a plan, which is buying someone else's elapsed time, and it is faked by the seed in the ground counted as the crop; not Staggered stand, which is the purchase of starting, since Gestation is the reason the stand is the only purchase, and not Calendar with nothing in it, since here the time is an ingredient and something is growing in it.

items.item: Clean months: a replacement that is a standing, a credit line, a licence, a lease, arrives only after the counterparty has watched a required run of periods, as the bank that wants two years of filed accounts, the credit file's seven years after a discharge, the reinstatement after a suspension, the landlord who wants references from the last address; the lead time is the counterparty's evidence rule, the carrier is a record kept in a form the counterparty reads, it is shortened by a guarantor who lends their own record, a co-signer, a vouching institution, and it is faked by the shell with a new name, which is Gestation's later-stage purchase applied to a record and is fraud; adds to who-can-be-bound's time to acquire a hold the guarantor as the purchase; not Gestation, where the thing itself grows and no one need watch, since here a witness must have been kept.
items.why: The fake is overclaimed and its phrase is ambiguous: 'the shell with a new name' reads as a phoenix company escaping its record, which is Calendar's under-the-table start, not a later-stage purchase; the actual later-stage purchase of a record (the aged shelf company, the borrowed tradeline, the bought business with its filed accounts) is legal to buy and fails for a mechanism the item does not state: the counterparty watches the party, not the vehicle, and re-attaches its watch on a change of control. Stating that mechanism keeps the adjacency's punch (the same move works at one item and is fraud at the next) and makes it true. 'Reinstatement after a suspension' also sits in both this item and Calendar with nothing in it; the repair says which reinstatement is meant. The citizenship case moved here from Gestation.
items.repair: Clean months: a replacement that is a standing, a credit line, a licence, a lease, arrives only after the counterparty has watched a required run of periods, as the bank that wants two years of filed accounts, the credit file's seven years after a discharge, the years of residence the state must have seen before citizenship, the reinstatement that wants a clean run since the suspension, the landlord who wants references from the last address; the lead time is the counterparty's evidence rule, the carrier is a record kept in a form the counterparty reads, it is shortened by a guarantor who lends their own record, a co-signer, a vouching institution, and it is faked by the aged shelf company and the borrowed tradeline, which are Gestation's later-stage purchase applied to a record and fail because the counterparty watches the party and not the vehicle and re-attaches its watch on a change of control, so the purchase turns into fraud exactly where it would have worked; adds to who-can-be-bound's time to acquire a hold the guarantor as the purchase; not Gestation, where the thing itself grows and no one need watch, since here a witness must have been kept.

items.item: Once a year: the market for the replacement opens on a period longer than many runways, as the academic hiring season, the football transfer window, the visa lottery, open enrolment, the harvest, the school year, so the lead time is the distance to the next window plus the window's own processing and the floor is quantized, a day late costing a cycle; the carrier is the window's calendar, it is shortened by nothing but timing the start, and it is faked by the application filed out of window, which is in the pile and in no queue; not Partner meeting, whose cadence is shorter than the runway and repeats inside it, since here one missed date is the whole death.
items.why: The discriminator against Partner meeting is a ratio, not a mechanism: 'whose cadence is shorter than the runway' makes the same committee a different item depending on the operator's cash, and misfiles a monthly credit committee faced with two weeks of runway. The mechanism that actually separates them is whose calendar it is: a window is the market's, shared by every counterparty, so a second counterparty is no shortener and parallel search beats nothing; a committee is one counterparty's own, so a second fund's Monday is a shortener. 'The harvest' as a market opening is loose; the repair reads it as the harvest crews' hiring.
items.repair: Once a year: the market for the replacement opens on a period longer than many runways, as the academic hiring season, the football transfer window, the visa lottery, open enrolment, the harvest crews, the school year, so the lead time is the distance to the next window plus the window's own processing and the floor is quantized, a day late costing a cycle; the carrier is the window's calendar, which every counterparty shares, so a second counterparty is no shortener and the wait is beaten by nothing but timing the start, and it is faked by the application filed out of window, which is in the pile and in no queue; not Partner meeting, whose calendar is one counterparty's own, so that a second fund's Monday is a shortener and parallel search beats the cadence, since here the calendar is the market's and parallel search beats nothing.

items.item: Rising floor: the lead time lengthens as the runway shortens, as the unemployed are hired slower than the employed, the firm at three months raises slower than at twelve, the seller with a closing date gets fewer offers, so the floor is not the lead time measured from strength but the fixed point where remaining runway equals the lead time at that remaining runway, and it sits higher; the carrier is the counterparty's reading of the remaining clock, it is shortened by starting from strength, before the clock is legible, and it is faked by the lead time quoted by someone who ran it from strength, since 'it took me six weeks' was measured at another point on the curve; observed in labour markets, analytical elsewhere; not Watched burn, which holds the buyer who waits for the price, since here even the willing arrive slower and the floor is a fixed point rather than a number.
items.why: As written the carrier is Watched burn's carrier and the separating clause 'even the willing arrive slower' has no mechanism behind it; the cited observation (duration dependence in hiring) is fewer engaging counterparties, not slower willing ones. The repair names the mechanism that makes this a different item from Watched burn: the clock read as a signal about the party thins the field and adds diligence, so the expected wait lengthens with no price moving; the fixed point, the shortener, and the fake are untouched, and the modality is split explicitly into observed, analytical, and by-analogy.
items.repair: Rising floor: the lead time lengthens as the runway shortens, as the unemployed are hired slower than the employed, the firm at three months raises slower than at twelve, the seller with a closing date gets fewer offers, so the floor is not the lead time measured from strength but the fixed point where remaining runway equals the lead time at that remaining runway, and it sits higher; the carrier is the counterparty's reading of the remaining clock as a signal about the operator rather than as a bargaining position, so the field thins, fewer counterparties engage at all and those who do add diligence, and the expected wait lengthens without any price moving; it is shortened by starting from strength, before the clock is legible, and it is faked by the lead time quoted by someone who ran it from strength, since 'it took me six weeks' was measured at another point on the curve; the thinning is observed in labour markets, the fixed point is analytical, and the extension to firms and sellers is by analogy; not Watched burn, which holds the buyer who reads the clock and waits for the price, since here the clock read as a signal removes counterparties rather than moving their terms, and the floor is a fixed point rather than a number.

items.item: Partner meeting: the replacement arrives on the counterparty's decision calendar rather than the operator's, as the fund's Monday partner meeting, the hiring committee that sits monthly, the credit committee that meets quarterly, the admissions round, the diocese's placement, so the lead time is the cadence of their meetings times the number of gates the decision must pass; the carrier is the counterparty's own process, it is shortened by a pre-signed paper, a standing term sheet, a pre-approved line, an offer held open, whose own fake is that the writer re-decides at exercise, as the credit line reviewed when drawn, and it is faked by the verbal yes, which is a decision not yet on their calendar; adds to runway-illusions' Watched burn, which reprices the terms, the arrival, since a counterparty can be willing and slow.
items.why: Tested as my closest neighbor against Once a year; separates on whose calendar it is (see neighbor_test). The pre-signed paper's own fake (the writer re-decides at exercise) is a real mechanism and the recruitment edge to No-shop holds.

neighbor_test.left: Once a year: the market for the replacement opens on a period longer than many runways, as the academic hiring season, the football transfer window, the visa lottery, open enrolment, the harvest, the school year, so the lead time is the distance to the next window plus the window's own processing and the floor is quantized, a day late costing a cycle; the carrier is the window's calendar, it is shortened by nothing but timing the start, and it is faked by the application filed out of window, which is in the pile and in no queue; not Partner meeting, whose cadence is shorter than the runway and repeats inside it, since here one missed date is the whole death.
neighbor_test.right: Partner meeting: the replacement arrives on the counterparty's decision calendar rather than the operator's, as the fund's Monday partner meeting, the hiring committee that sits monthly, the credit committee that meets quarterly, the admissions round, the diocese's placement, so the lead time is the cadence of their meetings times the number of gates the decision must pass; the carrier is the counterparty's own process, it is shortened by a pre-signed paper, a standing term sheet, a pre-approved line, an offer held open, whose own fake is that the writer re-decides at exercise, as the credit line reviewed when drawn, and it is faked by the verbal yes, which is a decision not yet on their calendar; adds to runway-illusions' Watched burn, which reprices the terms, the arrival, since a counterparty can be willing and slow.
neighbor_test.separating_case: A shop with two weeks of cash facing a bank whose credit committee sits monthly: by the author's discriminator (cadence longer than the runway, one missed date is the whole death) it lands in Once a year, yet a second bank's committee sits next Tuesday, so the wait is beaten by a second counterparty, which is Partner meeting's mechanism. In reverse, a new PhD with two years of savings and an October deadline: the cadence is far shorter than the runway, yet twenty departments share the one October, so no second counterparty shortens anything and a day late costs a year, which is Once a year. The two items do not collapse, but they separate on whose calendar it is (the market's, shared by every counterparty, versus one counterparty's own) and not on the ratio of cadence to runway; the author's discriminator misfiles both cases, and the repair to Once a year replaces it.

boundary_case: The source's own recovery: the surgeon's hand healing, the founder's months off after burnout, the plant rebuilt after a fire by the same firm. It is tempting because it is Gestation-shaped (elapsed time no money converts) and it draws a death line above zero (the operator must survive the healing). It is out by the of-sentence, which asks for the wait until a replacement arrives, not until the source returns, and velocity-bottlenecks' Recovery floor already holds tissue repair as a tempo constraint. The ruling teaches something the map should keep: a recovery is Gestation with no counterparty, so nothing on the third and fourth grades applies (no committee, no clause, no telling, no rising, since no one reads a clock on a source that is coming back), and Bridge is its only purchase, which is why the locum exists for illness before it exists for departure.

seriation.note: The endpoints are real (a lead time run to completion before the need; a lead time that cannot begin until the death) and the five grades are an itinerary that answers a live question, with Bridge as an honest coda. Two placements are loose rather than wrong. Calendar with nothing in it sits first in the third grade, but three of its four cases (the non-compete, the bankrupt's interval, the suspension) start their clock at the source's own end, so its placement holds on who starts the clock (the operator, at will) rather than on when it runs, and the note should say so. No-shop is filed under lead times that 'change the runway by running', but it changes the search, not the runway; the fourth grade's honest description is lead times that interact with the runway they must fit inside. The consequential adjacency, Gestation to Clean months, survives once Clean months' fake is repaired: the teaching is not purchase-then-fraud but a purchase that succeeds where the thing is bought and fails where the counterparty's watch re-attaches to the party, which is a sharper reason to separate the two than the one written. The hinge at Partner meeting to Ramp inside the floor holds as claimed.

edges.why: The claim is real (Rising floor's shortener, starting from strength, is when a search tells the source most) but the label states no failing antecedent, and the form_inference's 'the fixed point where the loop settles' conflates the r = L(r) fixed point, which the author's own separating case concedes belongs to Rising floor alone, with the two-edge cycle. The antecedent fails where searching is customary and a healthy source learns nothing from it; naming that makes the loop a claim and not a mood.
edges.repair_label: If the lead time lengthens as the runway shortens, the search must begin while the source still looks healthy, which is when a search tells the source most, since a healthy source expects none and reads the search as the only news; the antecedent fails where searching is customary, the academic market, the transfer window, the agent's annual round, and there the loop opens; elsewhere the two edges close a cycle whose only cut is the discreet channel, and the fixed point belongs to Rising floor alone, the cycle deciding only how early the operator meets it.

edges.why: 'If the ramp can be shortened only by overlap, the old source must host its own successor' is not entailed: overlap requires the old source to keep working, not to host. A second supplier can be qualified quietly while the first still ships, so the incompatibility bites only where the overlap needs the source's hand (knowledge, premises, permission), which is the employee's and the retiring engineer's case. Conditioning on that keeps the incompatibility and names where it fails.
edges.repair_label: If the ramp can be shortened only by overlap, and the overlap needs the old source's hand, its knowledge, its premises, or its permission, then the old source must host its own successor and so must know of the search, so past that point one cannot both overlap and use a discreet channel; the antecedent fails where overlap needs only that the old source keep working, as the second supplier qualified quietly while the first still ships, and the employee who cannot start the new job while keeping the old one is on the wrong side of the incompatibility.

edges.why: The fork's presence arm holds (a rush fee proves a queue and prices the floor) but the absence arm overclaims: 'if no one sells one, the wait was never a queue but an ingredient' is false for the social-housing list where expediting is forbidden, for Calendar with nothing in it, and for Once a year, all of which the map itself says no price shortens. As written the fork misroutes the operator at its most common outcome. The repair keeps the probe and sends the absence arm to the second probe.
edges.repair_label: If someone sells a shorter wait at any price, a rush lane, a private list, a side channel, then the wait was a place and the fee prices the floor; if no one sells one, the wait may still be a queue where expediting is forbidden, a rule's sentence, or a window, and only if something is growing in it was it an ingredient, so the expedite market is the operator's first probe and its absence sends them to the second, whether anything grows, anyone watches, or a rule names the date; the fork is real, but only one of its arms is decided by the fee.

edges.why: Antecedent (the search is visible to the source) can fail and the discreet channel is named as the cut; with the reverse edge repaired, the pair shows a cycle a sequence conceals.

Tested with a spare that does not decay (a stockpiled bolt): the antecedent fails cleanly and the dependency does not fire, which is what a conditional should do; where the spare decays (fuel, format, memory, a successor who leaves) the dependency is real.

Tested with a term sheet that carries no exclusivity (some seed notes): the antecedent fails and the recruitment does not fire; where it holds, the cure carrying the disease is the sharpest edge on the map.

modality_problems: Rising floor's separating clause 'even the willing arrive slower' asserts a mechanism the cited evidence does not support; the observed duration dependence in hiring is fewer callbacks, i.e. a thinned field, which the repair names.

Clean months' 'is fraud' is a flat overclaim about a legal purchase (an aged shelf company, a bought business with its accounts); the fraud is the misrepresentation on transfer, and the repair says why the purchase fails.

Internal contradiction: boundary_claim four says lead times on stopping, 'the notice on the operator's own commitments', belong to runway-illusions and are out, while Release at both ends admits 'on the near side the notice the operator must serve' as half its lead time. The item is right and the boundary claim is too broad: the cost of the notice (burn that continues) is runway-illusions' Burn you cannot put down; the delay the notice puts on the replacement's start is this map's. The boundary claim should be narrowed to the cost.

form_inference says the floor is 'the fixed point where the loop settles'; the author's own separating case concedes the fixed point belongs to Rising floor alone. The cycle decides how early the operator meets the fixed point, not where it is; the repaired edge label says this.

'As Toyota cut a die change from a day to minutes' is asserted as documented history; the documented single-minute-exchange-of-die figures are hours to minutes. Boundary claim three covers it, but 'hours' would cost nothing.

Calendar with nothing in it: 'the wait starts on the operator's own filing or leaving' is true, and it means three of its four cases begin at the source's own end; the seriation note places it as running 'at exercise on someone else's calendar' and should say the placement holds on who starts the clock, not when.
duplication: No grown list is duplicated by the map as a whole. Item-level borders to name: Rising floor as written shares its carrier with runway-illusions' Watched burn and is separated only by the repair; Release at both ends' near-side notice touches Burn you cannot put down, and the map's own boundary claim contradicts the item on it; velocity-bottlenecks' Apprenticeship floor, Fixed clock of consent, Trust formation, and Recovery floor sit under Gestation and Ramp inside the floor, Calendar with nothing in it and Longest-lead part, Clean months, and my boundary case, but there as tempo constraints with no carrier, shortener, fake, or clock relation, so this map adds to each rather than restating it; Staggered stand's missing cohort is a clocks-that-are-not-clocks reading, which the ledger already names as the next crossfield opening; survival-floors' Hiring hall is Place in line read as a floor rather than as a lead time, and Understudy's discriminator against Kept on call is correct.
best_unresolved_seed: The algebra the map uses but never states: which lead times add along a path (Release at both ends is a sum of two, and a hire is Partner meeting plus Release plus Ramp in series), which take the maximum (Longest-lead part over parts, Chain's longest link over a path through others), which take the minimum across candidates (parallel search across committees), which multiply (Partner meeting's cadence times its gates), and which convert one operator into another (No-shop turns a minimum across candidates into a sum; a discreet channel keeps the minimum; a window collapses every candidate to one date). The boundary claim admits that a real replacement runs several items in series and claims no coverage of that; a single item or a note that assigns each item its operator would let an operator compute a floor from the map instead of reading it, and would say exactly why No-shop is the most expensive clause on the list.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing four items (a misfiled example moved from Gestation to Clean months, a fake overclaimed as fraud, a discriminator that was a ratio rather than a mechanism, and a central item whose carrier duplicated Watched burn) and three edge labels whose antecedents could not fail as written.
